records.title: docs(xtask): replace phantom check-goals and metrics --write commands
records.release_claim: current automation documentation names commands that exist in the selected tree
records.reason: The scheduler command family was deleted before the freeze; retaining phantom commands would make operator and agent guidance false.
records.non_claim: The replacement documentation does not recreate repository-local execution authority.

records.title: docs(cli): document output-stream discipline
records.release_claim: machine output remains parseable on stdout while diagnostics, progress, and limitations use stderr according to the command contract
records.reason: The selected CLI, doctor, agent, and limited-scope changes add important disclosures; consumers need the stable stream boundary and its named baseline exceptions.
records.non_claim: Stream placement does not change the evidence strength of the emitted result.

records.title: docs(capabilities): add typed CommandSpec LSP projection to the capability matrix
records.release_claim: the capability matrix and machine capability source agree on typed command projection and its next checkpoint
records.reason: The production capability and metrics row already existed; omitting the buyer-facing projection leaves source-of-truth checks red and hides the bounded non-claim.
records.non_claim: The projection does not mean commands execute or that riprAgent handlers exist.

records.title: test(xtask): close the last unguarded CWD-relative read and make repository-CWD restoration panic-safe
records.release_claim: the complete xtask suite remains deterministic under parallel execution and restores global CWD even after a panic
records.reason: This closes the last known race in the #2186 family and is needed for exact-candidate proof, not runtime semantics.
records.non_claim: The guard does not alter report contents or product behavior.

records.title: refactor(cli): extract check, gate, and baseline command families
records.reason: The command implementations move into focused modules while dispatch and public behavior remain unchanged; selected semantics still come from their existing owners.
records.non_claim: Module extraction does not change gate, baseline, or check authority.

records.title: refactor(cli): extract agent, receipt, and context command families
records.reason: This decomposes high-conflict command code without changing artifact, receipt, scope, or validation behavior. Required trust changes remain classified by their semantic commits.
records.non_claim: Extraction does not complete receipt trust or execute verification.
